I answered Hollis in the thread in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**. It's the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging, which froze when scanning the bill-of-lading barcode.

That number comes from a message Tobias Rendle posted in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025. Hollis is a member of that channel and was part of that conversation. In the same thread, Tobias corrected himself to say the ticket is Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. I didn't find a newer ticket for this issue in #central-team. There are no Tansleigh files in the shared folders, so I couldn't check the ticket against a ticket record.
